tagline: The dark counterpart of streak tracking
audience: Athletes, founders, and creators who want a confrontational tracker that takes them seriously.

copy.HERO_HEADLINE: Show up. Mark it. Move on.
copy.HERO_LEDE: NOIR is the discipline tracker that doesn't congratulate you. It logs whether you showed up. That's it. That's the entire app.
copy.HERO_PILL: FOR PEOPLE WHO DON'T NEED PRAISE
copy.TRUSTED_BY_LABEL: Used by 9,400+ operators who don't want a parade
copy.FEATURES_LEDE: Each tool has one job. None of them ask anything of you beyond the daily mark.
copy.FEATURE_1_SUB: One tap per discipline per day. No streak counter. No emoji. No song.
copy.FEATURE_2_SUB: 30-day grid. Black squares for misses. White for shows. That's the whole UI.
copy.FEATURE_3_SUB: Counts how many times you reset a discipline. The honest metric.
copy.FEATURE_4_SUB: If you can't remember to log it, that's data. The app stays silent.
copy.FEATURE_5_SUB: No sharing, no leaderboards, no community. Discipline is private work.
copy.FEATURE_6_SUB: All your data, plain JSON, anytime. We don't lock you in.
copy.STEP_1_SUB: Name the discipline. One sentence. No goals, no deadlines, no fluff.
copy.STEP_2_SUB: Each day, did you show up. Yes or no. The app records the answer.
copy.STEP_3_SUB: Once a month, look at the grid. Adjust the protocol. Continue or stop.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_1_QUOTE: Finally an app that treats me like an adult. No glitter, no party hats. I trained 187 days last year. NOIR knows.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_2_QUOTE: I write every morning at 5:30. NOIR logs it. That's the contract. I've kept it 412 days.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_3_QUOTE: The reset count is the most useful number I've ever tracked. It taught me which disciplines I'm honest about and which I'm performing.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_4_QUOTE: Black background, white squares. That's it. Zero distraction. I check it for two seconds in the morning. Two seconds.
copy.CTA_BAND_LEDE: There's no trial. There's no pricing tier. There's a one-time payment and a tool that does its job.
copy.ABOUT_LEDE: We are a small group of athletes, writers, and engineers who got tired of habit apps that treated us like distracted children. So we built the opposite.
copy.ABOUT_STORY_BODY: NOIR began as a black-and-white spreadsheet. One column per discipline. One row per day. A 1 if you showed up, a 0 if you didn't. The spreadsheet worked. Friends asked for copies. The copies worked too. After two years of refining the spreadsheet, we wrote it as software. We deleted every feature that wasn't a column or a row. The app you're looking at is what was left. NOIR is for people who already know what to do and just want a tool that won't get in the way.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_1_SUB: No celebration animations. No streak GIFs. No reminders disguised as encouragement.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_2_SUB: We count what matters. Reset count. Days logged. Days missed. Nothing else.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_3_SUB: Pay once. Use forever. No subscription. Zero trickery.
copy.CONTACT_LEDE: Bug reports and feature requests. We don't promise to add what you ask for, but we read every message.
